main_text.l: Deum omnem turpitudinem execrari{a} ideoq;
nos eam penitus odisse & detestari debere{b},
contraq; tēperanter, modesté & casté{c}, sive in sacro
coniugio, sive in vita cœlibe, vivere oportere{d}.

l.i: Nihil ne amplius prohibet Deus hoc
præcepto, quàm adulterium, & id genus turpitudines?

main_text.l: Cùm corpus & animus nofter templa sint S.
S. vult Deus vt vtrunq; purè fanctèque possi-
deamus. Itaque facta, gestus, sermones{e}, cogi-
tationes, cupiditates fœdas{f}, & quicquid ho-
minem ad illa[?] allicit, id vniuersum prohibet{g},

l.i: Quid vetat Deus in octavo præcepto?

main_text.l: Non solùm ea furta{h}, & rapinas{i} quas ma-
gistratus punit: sed furti nomine comprehen-
dit, quidquid est malarum artium & aucupio-
rum, quibus aliena captamus, & ad nos vi aut
specie recti transferré{k} studemus: qualia sunt
iniquum pondus{l}, iniusta vlna, inæqualis men-
fura{m}, fucosa merx, fallax moneta, vsura{n}, aut a-
lia quæus[?] ratio aut modus rem faciendi à Deo
interdictus. His adde omnem auaritiam{o}, &
multiplicem diuinorum donorum profusio-
nem & abusum{p},

l.i: Quæ sunt ea quæ Deus hic iubet?

main_text.l: Vt commoda & vtilitates proximi, quan-
tum possim, adiuuem & augeam: cum eo sic a-
gam, vt mecum agi {q}cuperem: sedulò & fideli-
ter opus faciam, vt aliorum quoque egestati
ac calamitati subuenire {r}queam.

page.notes: Mark "d" note in the right margin is cut off at the page edge; "Heb.13.4" is only partly visible. "illa" after "ad" is uncertain (could be "ista"). "quæus" is uncertain (likely "quæuis"). Superscript marks e, f, g, k, l, m, o, p are read from small type and may be slightly off. Top margin note partly unreadable. The handwritten word "Quid" below the text is a manuscript annotation and is not transcribed.
